facts.fact: The StackAdapt article '3 martech trends shaping 2025 and beyond' was published on 2024-12-03.
StackAdapt says the article's trend insights come from industry experts featured in its guide, The Future of Martech.
facts.quote: based on the insights from various industry experts featured in StackAdapt’s guide, The Future of Martech

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, first-party data comes directly from customers through their interactions with the brand, such as website visits, purchases, or email subscriptions.
facts.quote: First-party data comes directly from your customers through their interactions with your brand—website visits, purchases, or email subscriptions.

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, zero-party data is information customers willingly provide, such as preferences or survey responses.
facts.quote: Zero-party data, on the other hand, is information customers willingly provide, such as preferences or survey responses.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that data privacy regulations such as the GDPR in Europe and the CCPA in California have reshaped how businesses collect, store, and use customer information.
facts.quote: Data privacy regulations like the GDPR in Europe and the CCPA in California have reshaped how businesses collect, store, and use customer information.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that third-party cookies, long the backbone of digital advertising, are taking a backstage role.
facts.quote: Third-party cookies—the backbone of digital advertising for years—

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, contextual targeting uses the content of a webpage or app to deliver relevant ads instead of relying on user-specific data.
facts.quote: Instead of relying on user-specific data, this approach uses the content of a webpage or app to deliver relevant ads.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes martech as focused on managing relationships and personalizing engagement, while adtech drives the automation and optimization of advertising.
facts.quote: While martech focuses on managing relationships and personalizing engagement, adtech drives the automation and optimization of advertising.
